fields.subject: ArgentSea.Orleans.Pg ArgentSeaOrleansReminderTable
fields.condition: a reminder is read, upserted or removed
fields.trigger: the reminder routines of tenant.psql run on the grain's shard
fields.response: UpsertRow inserts a new reminder at version 0 or, for an existing one, writes version current+1, returning it through the INOUT p_new_version argument; an etag that no longer matches raises SQLSTATE AS001, which propagates; RemoveRow deletes only when the version matches and returns the INOUT p_is_found flag; ReadRow returns the stored entry or, when none exists, an entry bearing only the grain id; a hash-range read excludes begin, includes end and wraps around when begin >= end; grain hashes are stored as bigint so values above int.MaxValue are accepted
fields.postcondition: reminders stay on their grain's shard and every row is returned with its version as the etag
